title: Upgrade data for Dynamics SL cloud migration

facts.text: Data replication must complete for companies being migrated before running data upgrade.
Ask active Business Central users to finish tasks and sign out before starting data upgrade.
When data upgrade starts, all client connections are terminated and cannot reconnect until upgrade completes.
Open Cloud Migration Management page and select Run data upgrade to schedule upgrade process.
Data upgrade transforms Dynamics SL tables into Business Central tables.
Hotfixes and scheduled tasks cannot run during data upgrade to prevent database locks and errors.
